case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests repeatedly praised the hostel's central location and, in some reviews, brightness, cleanliness, and comfortable beds/showers. Negative comments mention small or damp bathrooms and rooms, noise and construction disturbance, cleanliness problems (towels, dead insect, smelly refrigerator), curt or absent reception and communication issues, and extra charges for towels or luggage; one guest noted no breakfast offering.

review_summary_metadata.summary_method: Neutral LLM summary of the frozen recent review sample; no additional reviews retrieved.

priorities.recommendation: Immediately inspect rooms/bathrooms for mould/ventilation/water-intrusion; schedule pest-control-inspection, remediate per-maintenance/pest-control-guidance, document, and commission technical assessment before capital remediation decisions.

priorities.area: Cleanliness and housekeeping (towel-change policy, shared facilities)
priorities.recommendation: Review housekeeping frequency and towel policy; audit cleaning/pest control; update scripting and evaluate guest communications.
Review front-desk staffing and procedures, provide coaching, implement measurable follow-up, monitor guest reports after changes.
Order immediate deep-clean rooms/kitchen; commission/document pest treatment; allow towel changes/update info; implement manager-signoff daily/turnover checklist and 4-week spot-audits.

priorities.area: Staff service & communication (reception responsiveness, friendliness, information)
priorities.recommendation: Review reception-rosters to ensure-24-hour-coverage/fill-gaps-immediately; refresh front-desk communication/empathy/complaint-handling/apologies; create check-in-script and one-page welcome-sheet.

priorities.area: Room condition & maintenance (damp, uneven floors, small bathrooms)
priorities.recommendation: Inspect/repair damp or uneven rooms, remediate mold, re-room guests, tag/remove until corrected or described.
